description: The module's membership of the shared PBS backup job, and the retention/placement policy that governs it.
_note: update-service.sh re-asserts membership in the shared job and migrates a legacy --all job to the managed model — a set operation over the job's vmid list, plus a schedule/retention apply. That is a reconcile with domain knowledge (see lib/pbs-job.sh, lib/pbs-placement.sh), not a per-field set, so every field is apply:'reconcile'. Backup policy is also a CASCADE (site → environment → module, ADR-007 P9): the effective value is resolved by backup-manager, and a per-field differ here would compare only the module layer and call the rest drift.

backup.note: The module's layer of the retention/exclude/enabled cascade. Changing it changes future backups only; nothing already stored is touched, and no guest is disturbed.

alwaysBackup.note: Set only on the backup module itself: the modules whose VMs are always in the job even though they cannot declare dependsOn backup:vm (the foundation VMs that bootstrap before the backup server).

pbsStorageName.note: Which PBS datastore the job writes to.

immutableSnapshots.note: Periodic read-only ZFS snapshots of the datastore so backup history cannot be rewritten (ADR-012 §3.5). Enabling it provisions on the PBS node, not on the consuming guest.

placement.note: Where the module's backups are allowed to live (auto / a named target).

placementState.note: The resolved outcome of that placement, recorded on the deployed config.

pushTarget.note: An off-site datastore this module's backups are pushed to (ADR-010).
